purpose: Matched linear versus invertible neural state observation proxies in three closed-loop camera benchmarks

braking.endpoint_m: absolute difference between final obstacle distance and the 4 m target center

hover.endpoint_m: norm of final physical displacement from the hover reference

crane.endpoint_m: norm of final load position relative to the goal

design: Three paired optimization seeds per task. Same exogenous scenarios across the six frozen systems within each task. Sample each arm from the images rendered at that arm's actual state.
primary: Trajectory calibration radius q for maximum absolute error after each observer's own inverse on normalized physical coordinates; compare within task. Independently recompute and audit each arm against the same task-specific backend.
secondary: certification acceptance and fraction of certificate radius budget used
whole-trajectory coverage and observed safety and target attainment

holdout.score: same score as calibration including every observed time and coordinate

paired_estimation: Average each difference over the three frozen seed pairs for the same scenario, then bootstrap the 100 scenario indices. Per-contrast 95% percentile intervals with 10000 draws; do not treat three control outputs on the same scenario as three independent observations, and do not infer variability across training runs.
scope: The q budget is the largest radius accepted by the chosen sufficient model check, not the empirical collision threshold. A different physical benchmark has a different radius unit and backend.
